A story in three choices

Pick one line from each section. Read the three lines in order, or write them down to make a short story. No timer, account, or saved progress.

Inspired by Krownlandia Storytelling (Bookstore), credited to @michaelnottoli in the historical inventory (page 13). The fictional lines are from the prototype workshop at Whispering Pines. No bookstore venue is built.

1. Choose a beginning

  • By the river: A visitor began the morning beside the river.
  • Under the pines: A visitor began the morning under the pines.

2. Choose a discovery

  • A paper map: Along the path, they found a paper map folded into a tiny boat.
  • A distant bell: Along the path, they heard a bell ringing softly beyond the trees.

3. Choose an ending

  • A neighbor joins: A neighbor joined them, and they walked together to see what was ahead.
  • A story to tell: Back at the glade, the visitor told the story to someone taking a rest.
Try a different retelling

Keep the same beginning and discovery, then choose the other ending. Did your visitor go somewhere new or return to tell the story? Now add one sentence of your own after the discovery to help the listener picture what happens next.

To try the button version in the park, visit the Whispering Pines story board or bench and open Krownlandia Storytelling · Make a short story.
